record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare CURSE: Galar Corsola (1 star) and Cursola (2 stars); both range 1, maxPP 100, no passive. The strategy is shared; the only unit difference is the star index into the delay table.
record.summary: Needs no target and no cast animation from the base class. Among all enemies on the board it picks one at random from those with the highest maxHP and applies the Curse status to it with a delay of 8000 ms (1 star) / 5000 ms (2 stars), shortened by AP and by crit power if the cast crit. When the delay runs out the cursed unit takes 9999 TRUE damage. Rune Protect blocks it; an already cursed target dies immediately; a cleansed curse keeps its remaining time plus 2000 ms. Crit is only rolled when the caster has the ABILITY_CRIT effect. Nothing happens beyond the PP spend if no enemy exists.

targeting.who: one enemy: random among enemies whose maxHP equals the highest enemy maxHP, anywhere on the board
targeting.note: enemies are every non-empty board cell with a different team; selection uses maxHP (not current HP). With no enemies, Math.max of an empty list is -Infinity, the filter is empty, pickRandomIn returns undefined and the guard skips the curse.

geometry.shape: single unit, whole board, no distance limit

effects.scaling: requested delay = table value x (1 - 0.2 x AP/100) x (crit ? 1 - (critPower - 1) x 0.2 : 1), clamped to >= 0 by min(0). AP and critPower are the caster's at cast time. The delay is a duration, not damage; Big Eater Belt and Twist Band do not touch it.
effects.resolution: requested delay -> applied timer in triggerCurse: blocked entirely by Rune Protect; if the target is already cursed the cooldown is set to 0 (curse resolves on its next update); if the curse flag is off but a leftover cooldown > 0 exists (cleansed earlier) the timer becomes min(leftover, requested); otherwise the timer is requested + 1000 ms per Odd Keystone in the target player's items (only if the target has a player).

effects.target: the cursed enemy when its curse cooldown reaches 0
effects.scaling: none (fixed 9999; the caster's AP is not applied to the damage)
effects.resolution: requested 9999 -> pokemon.handleDamage with attackType TRUE and no attacker: defenses do not apply and no attacker bookkeeping occurs; shields, takenDamage and the minimum of 1 are handled by handleDamage as in core-mechanics §A (not re-traced here). The CURSE_EFFECT animation is broadcast afterwards.

statusEffects.effect: curse: flag on the picked enemy, resolves into 9999 TRUE damage when curseCooldown <= 0; blocked by Rune Protect; clearNegativeStatus clears the flag but keeps the cooldown +2000 ms

starBehavior.note: table index is the casting entity's stars; 3000 and 1000 ms are not reached at the factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None; the target can be anywhere on the board. Only enemies with the highest maxHP are eligible.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state in the strategy. Casting again on a target that is already cursed (possible when it is still the highest-maxHP enemy) sets its cooldown to 0, so the second cast resolves the curse on the next status update.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: delay 8000 / 5000 ms (1 / 2 stars). Requested = raw x AP factor x crit factor (>= 0); applied = requested, or min(leftover, requested) after a cleanse, or requested + 1000 ms per Odd Keystone, or 0 if the target is already cursed, or nothing under Rune Protect. The eventual damage is a fixed 9999 TRUE; takenDamage as reported by handleDamage was not traced here.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence) - only the castAbility gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT gate in castAbility was read; handleDamage internals for TRUE damage were not re-traced beyond core-mechanics §A
unresolved: Whether the 9999 TRUE damage can be fully prevented by shields or other effects inside handleDamage (looked up in core-mechanics §A, not re-traced here)
Which statuses besides Rune Protect and clearNegativeStatus can end a curse early (not searched exhaustively)
Whether the three-star and four-star delays are reachable for these units
Targets with a player-owned Odd Keystone only matter when the target entity has a player reference (not verified for enemy-side units)
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
